text:
nora-partnerships: Quick flag - Nitro just updated lead times for next-gen racks. Some reserved orders for late-August may slip. Need to prioritize customers + marketplace SKUs.
rachel-marketplace: Which SKUs? we have two co-sell SKUs scheduled for launch 8/20 (sku-rw-echo and sku-rw-aurora).
eli-nitro: Confirmed: assembly delay on connector sublots. ETA shift: +10-16 days for affected batches. We can reassign partial shipments but need priority list.
ovar-si: Our SI partners (CloudBridge) have two integration pilots tied to sku-rw-echo; delay may break go-live dates. They asked if cloud VMs can be used as a stop-gap.
drew-ops: Ops inventory: 9 racks earmarked for August; at risk = 4 racks across regions. Which customers are high-impact?
viv-sales: High impact: acct-mariner (enterprise reserved), acct-verve (marketplace launch partner), acct-tidel (pilot). Mariner has contractual delivery language.
nora-partnerships: Action: decide priority for partial shipments and fallback plan for marketplace SKUs. Options: 1) expedited partial racks from Nitro with fee, 2) marketplace VM fallback, 3) GPU swap (A10) for non-latency-critical tenants. Thoughts?
eli-nitro: We can expedite up to 2 racks this week for priority customers at a 7% expedite fee. Need PO refs and signed swap/expedite ack.
rachel-marketplace: Marketplace can provision reserved VMs in region-us-east-1 within 5 days, but SKU page visibility and billing sync take 24h. Also performance and KV cache caveats.
frank-legal: For expedite acks, we need a one-off amendment template with fees and swap notice. I can draft a short addendum today.
ovar-si: If we use marketplace VMs for the SI pilots, CloudBridge needs an API key mapping and a dev environment to validate. That adds ~48h of integration work.
drew-ops: Ops mitigation: allocation policy to split traffic and warm caches. Example snippet: 
```
fallback_v2:
  target_group: reserved-august
  fallbacks:
    - marketplace_us_east_1: 70%
    - dedicated_partial: 30%
  cache_warm: true
  kv_prefix: "mariner_" 
```
viv-sales: Pricing note: marketplace fallback will increase costs; we should offer credits to launch partners. I'll propose 15% service credit for the first month.
nora-partnerships: Good. @eli-nitro can you lock 2 expedited racks for Mariner + Verve if we confirm by EOD?
eli-nitro: Yes, can hold for 12 hours pending PO. Earliest ship if expedited: 2026-08-05.
frank-legal: Drafting expedite amendment now; will include customer opt-in language and indemnity for hardware delays.
rachel-marketplace: I'll mark sku-rw-echo and sku-rw-aurora with a temporary note: "Limited expedited availability; fallback to cloud VMs may apply."
nora-partnerships: Omar, can CloudBridge accept marketplace fallback for their pilots?
ovar-si: They'll accept as long as we provide a temp SLA and clear migration path. I'll coordinate with Rachel for keys.
drew-ops: Opening incident INC-2026-0827 to track actions and costs.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-0827 created by drew-ops  "Partner assembly delay affecting August Dedicated reservations"  priority: P2.
viv-sales: I'll contact Mariner and Verve with two options: expedite (cost + 7% fee) or marketplace fallback (15% credit + performance caveats).
frank-legal: Send any customer-facing language to me before outreach.
eli-nitro: Sending formal delay notice + QC log to partnerships@redwood.com in 45m.
nora-partnerships: Action list: @viv-sales customer decisions by EOD, @eli-nitro PO hold/ETA confirmation, @rachel-marketplace SKU banner + billing sync, @frank-legal amendment, @ovar-si integration window, @drew-ops incident + allocation policy. Sync tomorrow 09:30 in #partnerships. :thumbsup:
